purpose: 主界面的永久环境底层；只提供山水、建筑、道路和动态资产安装位，不重复绘制独立动画层。
composition: A locked 16:9 elevated three-quarter view of a secluded Chinese cultivation farm valley. Place a white-wall, green-tile cave residence across the rear center, layered blue-green mountains and soft clouds in the distance, a dry stone waterfall chute and recessed stream channel along the left, bamboo and an open pavilion along the right, and a broad empty circular mounting terrace in the center. Arrange six reusable radial garden display bays around the terrace, connected by curved stone paths and narrow recessed water channels. These are visual staging areas dynamically reused by the current production portfolio, never permanent one-species slots. Preserve calm negative space across the top HUD band, outer side edges, and lower navigation band. Keep all overlay attachment zones aligned to the composition reference.
visual: A bright, healing, high-quality rounded 2D Chinese cultivation landscape with clean animation-film linework, soft cel shading, broad color shapes, jade green vegetation, warm ivory stone, teal roof tiles, and pale golden sunlight. Buildings use authentic Chinese timber and tiled-roof forms with softened corners. The static plate contains structural scenery only: an empty waterfall chute, a neutral stream bed, a blank central formation socket, and clean planting bays. It excludes active water ribbons, the waterwheel rotor, formation rings, crystal, crops, characters, and magical light so independently animated overlays have one unambiguous visual owner.
must_include: High-quality rounded non-pixel 2D Chinese cultivation game art
One empty central formation mounting terrace and six reusable garden display bays
Readable paths between every visual staging area
Empty waterfall, stream, waterwheel, formation, crop, and character attachment zones
Soft daylight with a consistent upper-left light direction
Opaque full-canvas background with no empty borders
must_avoid: pixel art or pixel-grid edges
noise, grain, dithering, paper texture, or rough brush texture
oversharpening, edge enhancement, jagged contours, or chromatic aberration
photorealistic or 3D-rendered materials
dark horror atmosphere, science-fiction objects, or Western architecture
baked text, numerals, logos, watermarks, labels, or UI controls
characters, planted crops, treasure chests, magical particles, or animated-effect residues
dense micro-detail that would flicker when animated overlays are added
active waterfall water, active stream surface, waterwheel rotor, formation rings, spirit crystal, or double-drawn animation content
one fixed crop species permanently assigned to each display bay

composition: A wide transparent foreground strip viewed from the same elevated camera as the main scene. Build asymmetrical clusters of broad bamboo leaves, tender grasses, small rounded rocks, and a few soft wildflowers from the bottom edge and lower corners. Keep the central 55 percent mostly open, keep the upper half sparse, and use only a few overlapping leaf tips to create depth without hiding the central formation or bottom navigation controls.
visual: Rounded hand-drawn foliage with smooth deep-jade silhouettes, lighter leaf undersides, soft cel-shaded volume, warm green rim light, and restrained pale-gold flower accents. Each leaf cluster has a clear stem structure suitable for later image-to-video swaying. Edges are clean and stable, with no tiny serrations or painted texture.

Sparse center and denser lower corners
Clearly separated leaf clusters suitable for gentle secondary motion
Lighting and palette matched to the main environment

Leave the right half visually quiet and empty for runtime-rendered Chinese title text.

Use clean stable linework, smooth filled shapes, soft cel shading, and a handcrafted Chinese seal sensibility without reproducing a literal stamped character. The mark must remain legible when reduced to a compact header.

purpose: 承载四个常驻主入口；其余功能通过场景热点、条件按钮或二级菜单出现。
composition: A compact centered bottom navigation tray for exactly four primary game entrances. Provide four large evenly spaced circular icon anchors with broad transparent gaps, a low rounded jade-and-warm-ivory base, and a shallow silhouette that leaves most of the scene visible. Do not include any icons, labels, notification dots, secondary shortcuts, or more than four anchor positions.
visual: Warm-ivory and pale-jade rounded 2D UI shell with soft translucency, thin muted-gold edging, restrained carved-cloud corner details, and a gentle soft shadow. The dock supports icons while allowing the animated landscape to remain visible and dominant.
must_include: Exactly four primary icon anchor positions
Compact centered width with generous spacing
Transparent outer canvas and softly translucent rounded base
Empty anchors for runtime icons and labels
Low-density game navigation rather than a toolbar

desktop taskbar, web-admin sidebar, dense menu, or card-grid styling

visual: Rounded warm-ivory jade UI frame with a pale-green inner wash, thin muted-gold outer rim, soft cel-shaded depth, and a restrained shadow. The center remains plain so many different runtime icons stay readable.
